purpose: Machine-readable physical micro-surface contract for benchmark-visible park/street furniture. It governs material-scale manufacture evidence only and awards no Visual Fidelity points without actual Unity 3840x2160 renders.
renderPipelineAssumption: Unity built-in Standard metallic workflow used by the current migration branch; final scoring must come from the actual project runtime rather than this contract.

uvPolicy.generalFurnitureMeshes: rewrite UV0 to dominant-face planar coordinates in physical metres after manufactured assemblies exist
uvPolicy.stainlessChute: retain authored UV topology; U spans the modeled 0.92 m width and V follows the approximately 4.2 m chute run; apply non-uniform physical tiling
uvPolicy.agedDiffuser: retain lathed circumference/profile UV topology; derive tiling from 0.43 m maximum diameter and 0.255 m profile height
forbidden: one 0..1 texture repeat per object regardless of physical dimensions
random macro dirt inside the manufacturing microtexture
texture scaling chosen only to make a pattern visibly obvious

painted_steel.manufacture: exterior coating over steel tube/plate; the coating is the optically visible dielectric surface
painted_steel.microstructure: low-amplitude orange-peel/coating texture plus subtle chalking variation; no directional light information
painted_steel.wetness: dry benchmark default; rain state may lower roughness locally but this generator does not paint wet patches
painted_steel.uvAging: sun-exposed coating may chalk/desaturate macroscopically in the separate cause-based weathering system
painted_steel.angularResponse: dielectric Fresnel from the shader/environment; no metallic edge tint and no painted highlight
painted_steel.geometryVsMaterialDetail: pipe diameter, rail joints and fasteners are geometry; orange-peel below sub-millimetre scale is normal/roughness detail

stainless_chute.manufacture: formed 2.0 mm SUS304-class chute skin and side sheets; repeated use creates abrasion predominantly along travel direction
stainless_chute.finish: used stainless with fine directional travel scratches
stainless_chute.microstructure: fine grooves run along chute travel direction; broad reflections remain generated by real sky/reflection probes
stainless_chute.wetness: dry benchmark default; wet stainless would reduce effective roughness but is not simulated by static painted highlights
stainless_chute.uvAging: no paint chalking; contamination/weathering belongs to separate causal layers
stainless_chute.angularResponse: metal Fresnel/environment reflection grows strongly at grazing angles; actual amount must be judged from grazing-light render
stainless_chute.geometryVsMaterialDetail: 2 mm shell thickness and 140 mm side sheets are geometry; fine abrasion below pixel-scale silhouette is normal/roughness detail
stainless_chute.metallicWorkflowCorrection: the construction bootstrap material used 0.86 metallic for early scalar lookdev; this final microdetail pass intentionally overrides bare stainless to 1.0 because exposed metal in a metallic workflow should not be represented as a partially dielectric bulk surface

exposed_steel.manufacture: uncoated steel hardware/bearer/cap surfaces where metal remains optically exposed
exposed_steel.finish: aged exposed metal without a broad rust paint-over
exposed_steel.microstructure: fine machining and oxidation-scale roughness variation; no macro rust streaks in this texture
exposed_steel.wetness: dry default; wetness would lower roughness locally
exposed_steel.uvAging: not applicable as paint UV chalking
exposed_steel.angularResponse: true metallic reflection from environment lighting/probes
exposed_steel.geometryVsMaterialDetail: bolt/cap/bearer thickness is geometry; machining scratches are material detail

bench_timber.manufacture: five exterior timber seat slats with grain running along each slat length
bench_timber.microstructure: lengthwise grain with restrained fine checking; no dark line is allowed to masquerade as the real 15.5 mm slat gaps
bench_timber.wetness: dry default; rain may darken timber and lower roughness only through a future causal rain state
bench_timber.uvAging: up-facing surfaces may bleach/desaturate more than protected undersides in macro weathering
bench_timber.angularResponse: broad dielectric response; polished contact edges may become locally smoother only where use explains it
bench_timber.geometryVsMaterialDetail: five slats and air gaps are geometry; grain/checks are texture-scale detail

precast_concrete.manufacture: precast bench supports and concrete lamp-pole segments with fine aggregate and small casting pinholes
precast_concrete.microstructure: fine aggregate and sparse pinhole-scale relief with no fake contact shadow
precast_concrete.wetness: dry benchmark default; capillary/contact darkening is represented by the separate contact-concrete material
precast_concrete.uvAging: minor mineral tone shift only; no metallic/glossy aging
precast_concrete.angularResponse: broad rough dielectric lobe under coherent sun/sky fill
precast_concrete.geometryVsMaterialDetail: support dimensions and pole taper are geometry; aggregate/pinhole relief is material detail

contact_concrete.manufacture: same mineral substrate at ground-contact/splash/capillary zones
contact_concrete.finish: darker and rougher because the interface sees splash, soil fines and repeated moisture
contact_concrete.microstructure: slightly coarser mineral relief than the protected precast face; no painted AO line
contact_concrete.wetness: causal ground-contact state; not globally wet and not glossy in the dry benchmark
contact_concrete.geometryVsMaterialDetail: contact-zone height is established by assembly geometry/material assignment; micro-pits are material detail

notice_backing.manufacture: weathered board/backing within a four-rail frame
notice_backing.microstructure: restrained fibre/coating texture; no modern printed digital graphics are introduced
notice_backing.wetness: dry default; top-edge runoff belongs to separate causal weathering
notice_backing.uvAging: upper/sun-facing board may fade macroscopically; this tile remains neutral microstructure
notice_backing.geometryVsMaterialDetail: panel thickness/frame/fasteners are geometry; fibre texture is material detail

aged_diffuser.manufacture: retained-ring globe-era diffuser with aged/frosted polymer or glass-like dielectric surface
aged_diffuser.microstructure: fine frosting/aging breakup only; silhouette comes from the lathed five-point profile
aged_diffuser.uvAging: subtle haze/yellowing may occur macroscopically but no emissive glow is allowed
aged_diffuser.angularResponse: dielectric Fresnel; must not read as chrome or emissive plastic
aged_diffuser.geometryVsMaterialDetail: retained collars and globe profile are geometry; frost is material detail

causeSeparation.rule: The tile generator must stay direction-neutral with respect to sun/camera and must not create a random generic dirt mask.

lookdev.illustrationStatus: PRECISE_GENERATION_BRIEF_RECORDED; repository image ingestion is not available in the current connector-only execution path

generationBrief.layout: single 3840x2160 contact sheet, four equal material studies plus two detail strips
generationBrief.study1: 2 mm SUS304 slide skin viewed frontal, 35-degree oblique and near-grazing under one coherent midsummer sun; show travel-direction hairline abrasion without baked white streaks
generationBrief.study2: five timber bench slats with real air gaps; grain runs along 3.02 m slat length, slight UV bleaching on upward faces, no dark texture line substituting for geometry
generationBrief.study3: precast concrete support transitioning into a lower capillary/splash band; aggregate/pinholes visible at 100% crop, no painted AO
generationBrief.study4: painted steel tube and exposed fastener under the same sun/sky; coating is dielectric, bare hardware is metallic, both show believable grazing response
generationBrief.detailStripA: lathed aged lamp diffuser in daylight, unlit, retained-ring silhouette visible, subtle frost only
generationBrief.detailStripB: notice-board backing/frame corner showing matte fibre/coating, separate metal fastener and no modern digital cue
negativeConstraints: no dramatic studio rim light inconsistent with benchmark sun
no wet-look gloss on dry wood/concrete
no random rust over stainless chute
no disaster, earthquake or reconstruction imagery

requiredEvidence: 3840x2160 frame with the furniture pass rebuilt before capture
100% crop of slide stainless under oblique or grazing light confirming directional abrasion is subtle and environment-driven
100% crop of bench timber showing physical-scale grain without repeating wallpaper appearance
100% crop of precast/contact concrete transition proving aggregate relief does not become noise or fake AO
100% crop of painted tube / exposed fastener confirming dielectric-vs-metal response
motion/LOD pass confirming microdetail does not create shimmer or visible LOD discontinuity
